pages.title: Fortnite Peely Smiling and Waving with His Banana Peel Tips Folded Back Coloring Page
pages.description: Peely smiles and waves on this printable coloring page, with banana peel tips folded back above his face and sturdy boots planted on a grassy island hillside. Rounded eyes and a wide mouth give the central figure clear features. The coloring sheet offers large open body areas with smaller pine trees, rocks, and distant cliffs.

pages.title: Fortnite Agent Peely Wearing His Tuxedo and Bow Tie While Carrying a Spy Briefcase Coloring Page
pages.description: Agent Peely carries a spy briefcase on this printable coloring page, wearing a tuxedo and bow tie while lifting one hand toward his lapel beside a coastal railing. A globe-style emblem decorates the case, and a modern building rises beyond the cliffs. The coloring sheet mixes broad suit areas with small buttons, laces, and palm leaves.

pages.title: Fortnite Golden Agent Peely Using a Keycard to Open the Circular Agency Vault Coloring Page
pages.description: Golden Agent Peely uses a keycard to open the circular Agency vault on this printable coloring page, reaching toward its reader in a suit and long tie. The huge door has a central wheel, locking bars, and repeated round fittings. The coloring sheet pairs broad clothing sections with small card lines, buttons, and vault hardware.

pages.title: Robot with a Drink Cup Head Waving in the Hills Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features the P-1000 robot with its Peely smoothie head, waving an articulated mechanical hand above a body of rounded armor and jointed limbs. A domed lid and bent straw top the smiling face. The coloring sheet includes broad robot plates with smaller joints, fingers, landscape trees, and a floating supply crate.

pages.title: Fortnite Polar Peely Emerging From His Thawing Giftbox in the Winterfest Lodge Coloring Page
pages.description: Polar Peely emerges from his thawing giftbox in the Winterfest Lodge on this printable coloring page, waving above torn wrapping paper beside a decorated tree and fireplace. Melting drips hang from his peel tips beneath a large wreath. The coloring sheet combines broad gift panels and body sections with detailed stonework, ornaments, and ribbon loops.

pages.title: Fortnite Unpeely Wearing His Straw Hat and Sunglasses While Relaxing in a Beach Chair Coloring Page
pages.description: Unpeely relaxes in a beach chair on this printable coloring page, wearing a straw hat and sunglasses with both arms tucked behind his head beside the sea. Palm-patterned shorts, a drawstring bow, and bare feet complete the pose. The coloring sheet contrasts large body areas with fine hat fringe, chair joints, and shoreline ripples.

pages.title: Fortnite Potassius Peels Wearing Roman Armor and a Cape Beside a Stone Column Coloring Page
pages.description: Potassius Peels leans beside a stone column on this printable coloring page, wearing Roman armor, a cape, and a laurel wreath above a smiling banana face. A lion emblem fills his breastplate, with leaf motifs on the armor and shin guards. The coloring sheet offers broad cape sections with smaller medallions, sandal straps, and column cracks.

pages.title: Fortnite Toon Peely with His Nanner Shake Back Bling and Oversized Cartoon Gloves Coloring Page
pages.description: Toon Peely gives a thumbs-up on this printable coloring page, wearing oversized cartoon gloves and shoes with his Nanner Shake back bling strapped behind his shoulder. The shake cup has a banana emblem, swirled topping, and straw. Broad body sections dominate the coloring sheet, with finer trees and wooden towers across the distant hills.

pages.title: Fortnite P33ly Wearing Cybernetic Armor and Carrying His Matching High-tech Pickaxe Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows P33ly wearing cybernetic armor and carrying his matching high-tech pickaxe, standing with round joint fittings and angular plates covering his arms and legs. A hexagonal chest panel anchors the suit design. The coloring sheet combines larger armor sections with small mechanical details, pine trees, and a distant flag-topped building.

pages.title: Fortnite Lil Split in His Banana Sundae Outfit with an Ice Cream Swirl and Cap Coloring Page
pages.description: Lil Split poses in his banana sundae outfit on this printable coloring page, raising two fingers beneath an ice cream swirl, cherry, and curved cap brim. Sprinkles cover his peel, and a small dessert-shaped pouch hangs across his chest. The coloring sheet mixes broad banana panels with smaller toppings, buckles, and boot straps.

pages.title: Peelverine Raising His Claws in a Wolverine Suit Coloring Page
pages.description: Peelverine stands with three claws extended from each hand on this printable coloring page, wearing his Wolverine suit with pointed mask panels and a circular X belt buckle. Bent knees and raised arms create a wide action pose. The coloring sheet offers large costume sections alongside narrow claws, armor borders, and distant pine-covered cliffs.

pages.title: LEGO Peely Touching a Spiked Creature's Face Coloring Page
pages.description: Lego Fortnite Island Adventure Peely meets Klombo beside a Nana Village on this printable coloring page, reaching up to the creature's broad smiling face in the Lost Isles. Raised huts, wooden bridges, and palms surround the pair. The coloring sheet offers large creature shapes with smaller spots, back spines, minifigure equipment, and village railings.

pages.title: Banana in a Toga Reading a Scroll Coloring Page
pages.description: Peelosopher Bananocrates reads the Nana Scroll on this printable coloring page, wearing a draped toga and laurel wreath between ancient columns above cracked stone paving. A leaf-shaped medallion secures his braided belt, and sandals wrap around his feet. The coloring sheet combines open scroll and garment areas with smaller leaves, rope strands, and distant temple details.

pages.title: Lego Fortnite Peely Minifigure Building a Log Cabin with a Stack of Wooden Pieces Coloring Page
pages.description: A Lego Fortnite Peely minifigure builds a log cabin on this printable coloring page, carrying a long wooden piece beside a stacked pile and an unfinished roof. Circular log ends and hook-shaped hands repeat across the scene. The coloring sheet contrasts broad banana and building sections with wood grain, pine branches, and smaller ground stones.

pages.title: Fortnite Springfielder Peely Walking Along a Springfield Street Lined with Houses Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Springfielder Peely walking along a Springfield street lined with houses, his long arms swinging beside a tall banana body with folded peel tips. Windows, garage doors, chimneys, and rounded trees fill the neighborhood behind him. Broad character and sidewalk areas balance the smaller house details on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Fortnite Peely Discovering a Loot Llama Beside a Fence on the Battle Royale Island Coloring Page
pages.description: Peely discovers a Loot Llama beside a fence on the Battle Royale island in this printable coloring page, smiling with both hands raised near his chest. The llama wears a large arrow-marked pouch and rows of layered fringe. The coloring sheet includes broad banana areas, fence planks, grass tufts, and a small hilltop watchtower.

pages.title: Fortnite Peely Descending Toward the Island While Holding an Umbrella Glider Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Fortnite Peely descending toward the island beneath an umbrella glider, with one arm raised and his legs dangling above the coastline. The segmented canopy and broad banana outline contrast with tiny roads, buildings, trees, and distant mountains across this detailed coloring sheet.

pages.title: Peely Holding Building Plans and a Pencil by a Fort Coloring Page
pages.description: Fortnite Peely studies a building blueprint while constructing a wooden fort in this printable coloring page, holding a pencil beside tall plank walls and stairs. Diagonal braces, round fasteners, and the small fort drawing add enclosed details to the coloring sheet around Peely's broad, open body.

pages.title: Fortnite Peely Holding a Rifle at a Wooden Fort Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Fortnite Peely guarding his fort entrance with an assault rifle held across his body, framed by pointed walls and a watchtower. Rope bindings, crossed supports, grass, and scattered stones give the coloring sheet smaller details around the large central character.

pages.title: Fortnite Peely Drinking a Small Shield Potion Beside a Pair of Slurp Barrels Coloring Page
pages.description: Fortnite Peely drinks a small shield potion beside two Slurp barrels in this printable coloring page, standing with one elbow raised and his other arm lowered. The bottle, barrel bands, knee patches, and strapped boots provide distinct sections, while broad blank areas keep this coloring sheet relatively uncluttered.

pages.title: Peely and Fishstick Fishing with a Catch on a Dock Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Fortnite Peely and Fishstick fishing from a wooden dock, with a dripping fish hanging from Peely's line between their rods. Rope-wrapped posts, water ripples, and a distant tree-covered bank surround the seated pair, adding fine background details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Peely and Fortnite Teammates Studying an Island Map Coloring Page
pages.description: Fortnite Peely plans a squad route with Meowscles and Cuddle Team Leader in this printable coloring page, pointing at an island map spread across a round table. The characters lean toward roads and tiny buildings on the map, while mountains, water, and trees fill the more detailed background of this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Fortnite Peely Performing the Nana Nana Dance with Both Elbows Bent and Feet Apart Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page captures Fortnite Peely performing the Nana Nana dance with bent elbows, outward-pointing thumbs, and his booted feet planted far apart on grass. A small Battle Bus floats above cliffs and a watchtower, balancing Peely's broad open outline with finer scenery on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Fortnite Peely Celebrating a Victory Royale While Wearing a Victory Crown Coloring Page
pages.description: Fortnite Peely raises both fists to celebrate a Victory Royale in this printable coloring page, wearing a pointed crown decorated with angular gems above his smiling face. Trees, layered cliffs, and a distant tower frame the figure, while the crown and knee patches add smaller shapes to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Fortnite Peely Riding a Driftboard Down a Grassy Slope with Both Feet on the Board Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page follows Fortnite Peely riding a Driftboard down a grassy slope, with bent knees and both arms extended beside his smiling banana face. Circular board details, scattered stones, and pine trees create smaller sections around the large character and diagonal hillside on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Fortnite Peely Floating Above a Hill While Holding the Strings of Three Balloons Coloring Page
pages.description: Fortnite Peely floats above a grassy hill while holding three balloon strings in this printable coloring page, with his free hand stretched outward and boots suspended. Rounded balloons leave broad spaces to fill, while shoreline trees, cliffs, mountains, and a distant flagged tower supply finer details across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Fortnite Peely Roasting a Marshmallow on a Stick Beside a Stone-ringed Campfire Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Fortnite Peely roasting a marshmallow beside a stone-ringed campfire, seated on a log with a long stick held above the flames. Curved fire shapes, stacked logs, boot straps, and scattered grass offer varied sections to color around the character's open banana outline on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Fortnite Peely Stepping Through a Cracked Rift Portal with a View of the Island Beyond Coloring Page

A Battle Bus hangs above the island's roads, buildings, trees, and waterways, giving the coloring sheet a detailed landscape behind Peely's large foreground figure.

pages.title: Fortnite Peely Peeking Out From a Sneaky Snowman Disguise in a Snowy Clearing Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Fortnite Peely peeking from a Sneaky Snowman disguise in a snowy clearing, gripping the scarf beneath its lifted top-hatted head. A carrot nose, round buttons, stick arms, and snowy pine trees give this coloring sheet distinct shapes around the large snowman body.

pages.title: Fortnite Peely Carrying a Snowball Launcher Beside a Snow-covered Fort Coloring Page
pages.description: Fortnite Peely carries a snowball launcher beside a snow-covered fort in this printable coloring page, standing with both hands around the large weapon and smiling forward. The snowflake emblem, loaded snowball, draped roof snow, and small flag add contrasting details to the character's broad outline on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Fortnite Peely and Jonesy Running Toward a Bunker as the Volcano Erupts Behind Them Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Fortnite Peely and Jonesy running toward a bunker as a volcano erupts behind them, sending smoke and rocks above the island. Bent arms and lifted boots emphasize their movement, while the heavy doorway, scattered stones, and distant cliffs create angular sections across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Fortnite Agent Peely and Deadpool Standing Back to Back on the Deck of the Yacht Coloring Page
pages.description: Fortnite Agent Peely and Deadpool stand back to back on the Yacht deck in this printable coloring page, each holding a pistol upright beside the ship's railings. Peely's suit and glasses contrast with Deadpool's mask, belt pouches, and sword handle, giving this coloring sheet varied clothing and equipment details.

pages.title: Fortnite Kawspeely Descending Beneath His Balloon-shaped Far From Home Glider Coloring Page

X-shaped eyes and glove markings repeat across the design, while the plain background leaves the character and glider as the coloring sheet's main shapes.

pages.title: Fortnite Peely in Oasis Village Coloring Page
pages.description: Fortnite Peely stands among the palm trees and rounded buildings of Oasis Village in this printable coloring page, smiling on a winding path through the settlement. Arched doors, cacti, a distant well, and a wristwatch add small details, with broad walls and the banana body providing open spaces on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Fortnite Peely in Reality Falls Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Fortnite Peely at Reality Falls, waving from a rock ledge with a backpack on his shoulders and a waterfall behind him. Large leaves, angular rocks, water ripples, and spots along Peely's body create a mix of broad spaces and smaller shapes throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Fortnite Peely in Reckless Railways Coloring Page
pages.description: Fortnite Peely stands beside the tracks at Reckless Railways in this printable coloring page, with a steam locomotive and an arched station wall in the background. Stitched patches on his body, windows, wheels, and the station sign add enclosed details, while his tall central outline dominates the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Fortnite Peely in Frenzy Fields Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places Fortnite Peely in Frenzy Fields, wearing a jacket and tie in front of a barn, fenced farmland, and curving crop rows. His broad smile and curled peel frame the central figure, while jacket pockets and small seedlings provide distinct sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Fortnite Peely in Jungle Temple Coloring Page
pages.description: Fortnite Peely waves inside a jungle temple in this printable coloring page, wearing a backpack among carved pillars, hanging vines, and large leaves beside stone steps. Cracks, patterned bands, loose blocks, and the small banana emblem on his chest add fine sections around the character's broad outline on this coloring sheet.
